lint_candidates.replacement: say the one true thing: कड़क इलायची चाय, ₹30 में
lint_candidates.why: The 'not X, but Y' turn (यह X नहीं, बल्कि Y है) is one of six AI patterns a Hindi tech writer lists; Roman Hinglish included.
lint_candidates.evidence: India TV Hindi, Vineet Kumar Singh, 2026-08-25, https://www.indiatv.in/explainers/how-to-detect-ai-written-text-6-language-patterns-that-reveal-machine-writing-2026-08-25-1239356

lint_candidates.replacement: the real verb: चखिए, पहनकर देखिए, घूम आइए
lint_candidates.why: A calque of 'experience it' or 'a unique experience'; everyday Hindi names the action, and '20 साल का अनुभव' is not matched.

lint_candidates.replacement: मज़ा लीजिए, मज़े लो, or just the action
lint_candidates.why: A calque of the English 'Enjoy X' call to action; Hindi ad voice says मज़ा लीजिए or names the action.

lint_candidates.replacement: देखिए, देखो, ट्राई कीजिए
lint_candidates.why: A calque of 'discover' or 'explore'; खोजें is right only as a search-box label.

lint_candidates.replacement: say the result: GST बिल अब 2 मिनट में
lint_candidates.why: A calque of 'to new heights'; Roman Hinglish included.

lint_candidates.replacement: name the dish or the first step
lint_candidates.why: 'Journey' used as a metaphor (स्वाद की यात्रा); literal trips such as गोवा यात्रा are not matched.

lint_candidates.replacement: पक्का कर लें, ध्यान रखें, or cut it
lint_candidates.why: A calque of 'ensure' or 'make sure'; normal in government notices, stiff in a post.

lint_candidates.replacement: देते हैं, मिलेगा
lint_candidates.why: A calque of corporate 'we provide'; the everyday verb is देना.

lint_candidates.replacement: active voice: हमारे शेफ़ हर डिश ख़ुद बनाते हैं
lint_candidates.why: An English passive with an agent (by X it is done) carried into Hindi; Microsoft's voice rules say to avoid the passive.
lint_candidates.evidence: inference; Microsoft voice rules in Microsoft Urdu Style Guide, https://aka.ms/urdu-styleguide

lint_candidates.replacement: के लिए
lint_candidates.why: Bookish 'for'; standard on forms and notices, stiff in a caption.

lint_candidates.replacement: साथ ही, इसलिए, ऊपर वाला, नीचे दिए, फिर, चुनें, बदलें, देखें, दोबारा कोशिश करें
lint_candidates.why: Formal connectives and verbs; Microsoft's Hindi guide lists इसके अतिरिक्त, अतः, चयन करें, परिवर्तित करें, संदर्भ लें and पुनः प्रयास करें as too formal.

lint_candidates.replacement: बहुत, जल्दी, अभी, ख़रीदें, फ़्री
lint_candidates.why: Sanskritised words that are standard in notices and government schemes but read bookish in a brand post.

lint_candidates.replacement: start with the reader's problem: लंच छूट जाता है? 15 मिनट में सलाद
lint_candidates.why: The Hindi form of the 'In today's fast-paced world' opener (आज की भागदौड़ भरी ज़िंदगी में).

lint_candidates.replacement: open with the offer or the question
lint_candidates.why: A greeting or letter opener (प्रिय ग्राहक, नमस्ते दोस्तों) spends the first line; Roman forms included.

lint_candidates.replacement: ask a real question, or none
lint_candidates.why: Engagement bait (tag friends, like and share) in Devanagari or Roman Hinglish; platforms demote it.

lint_candidates.replacement: delete the chatbot framing
lint_candidates.why: Chatbot framing left in the copy (here are some captions, as an AI model).

lint_candidates.replacement: one script per line: shop karo, or शॉपिंग कीजिए
lint_candidates.why: A lowercase English verb in Latin letters with a Devanagari light verb (shop करें); people write mixed Hindi and English in Latin script, models put Devanagari into it; capitalised brand verbs (WhatsApp करें) are skipped.

lint_candidates.replacement: the concrete next step: मेन्यू देखें, ₹99 में ऑर्डर करें
lint_candidates.why: A generic call to action (learn more, for more information) translated from English.

lint_candidates.replacement: maze lo, try karo, dekho, pakka karo, dete hain
lint_candidates.why: Roman Hinglish lines carrying textbook Hindi calques (anubhav karein, khojein, sunishchit, pradaan); real Roman Hinglish uses the English verb or the everyday Hindi one.

lint_candidates.replacement: keep one आपका, drop the rest
lint_candidates.why: Three or more आपका/आपकी/आपके in one sentence, the Hindi form of 'your' in every phrase.

lint_candidates.replacement: Say the one thing plainly, e.g. القهوة عندنا تنطحن كل صبح (Gulf).
lint_candidates.why: The frame ليس مجرد X بل Y, ليس فقط and لا يقتصر على is the Arabic form of the calqued not-X-but-Y contrast that AI text leans on.

lint_candidates.replacement: Drop the scene setting and open with the offer, the day or the place.
lint_candidates.why: Scene-setting openers such as في عالم اليوم, في عصرنا الحالي and في ظل التطورات are stock AI and translated-English framing.
lint_candidates.evidence: amwaly.com guide on natural AI Arabic, https://tech.amwaly.com/blog/207411 (read); في عصرنا الحالي and في ظل are inference

lint_candidates.replacement: Cut the connector; use و, بس, or start a new short line.
lint_candidates.why: Essay connectors (علاوة على ذلك, بالإضافة إلى ذلك, من ناحية أخرى, في الختام, وبالتالي) are repeated filler in AI Arabic and do not occur in casual posts.
lint_candidates.evidence: Al-Rai, 7 fingerprints of AI text (Abdulaleem Al-Hajjar, 22 Mar 2026), https://www.alraimedia.com/article/1760414 (read); amwaly.com (read); وبالتالي is inference

lint_candidates.replacement: Use a real verb: فتحنا فرع جديد (dialect) or the MSA passive افتُتح.
lint_candidates.why: تم or يتم plus a verbal noun (تم افتتاح, يتم توصيل) is an auxiliary-verb calque of the English passive; Arabic uses the verb itself or the true passive.
lint_candidates.evidence: قطار الترجمة (Bushra L.), https://translatrain.com/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A9/ (read); Ahmed Jameel, Common Errors in Arabic Language Translations, https://ae.linkedin.com/pulse/common-errors-arabic-language-ahmed-jameel (read)

lint_candidates.replacement: Use the verb: نوصّل طلبك, not نقوم بتوصيل طلبك.
lint_candidates.why: قام بـ plus a verbal noun pads a simple verb and reads as translated report prose.
lint_candidates.evidence: Ahmed Jameel, Common Errors in Arabic Language Translations, https://ae.linkedin.com/pulse/common-errors-arabic-language-ahmed-jameel (read)

lint_candidates.replacement: Make the doer the subject: طهاتنا يحضّرونه كل صبح.
lint_candidates.why: من قبل, من طرف and بواسطة after a passive copy the English by-agent; Arabic puts the doer first as the subject.
lint_candidates.evidence: EnglishTips&Tools blog, passive translation errors, http://englishtipsandtools.blogspot.com/2013/10/blog-post_1890.html (read); قطار الترجمة (Bushra L.), https://translatrain.com/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A9/ (read)

lint_candidates.replacement: Plain word or dialect: بسرعة, واجد (Gulf), كتير (Levantine), أوي (Egyptian); drop يعتبر.
lint_candidates.why: بشكل plus an adjective, يعتبر and العديد من are report-register habits that read stiff on social, though they are sometimes correct.

lint_candidates.replacement: Name the action: جرّبوا, تعالوا, اطلبوا.
lint_candidates.why: انغمس في, أطلق العنان لـ and ارتقِ بـ render the English AI verbs immerse, unleash and elevate.

lint_candidates.replacement: State the fact instead: الطلب يوصلك حار خلال 20 دقيقة.
lint_candidates.why: Empty experience claims (تجربة فريدة من نوعها, استمتع بتجربة, كل ما تحتاجه في مكان واحد, وجهتك المثالية) stand in for a concrete fact.
lint_candidates.evidence: inference; amwaly.com names hollow descriptors as a tell (read)

lint_candidates.replacement: Drop the metaphor; name the dish, the place or the result.
lint_candidates.why: رحلة as a metaphor for tasting, beauty or success is a stock AI image in Arabic.

lint_candidates.replacement: Start a new short clause: فرعنا بجدة فيه جلسات عائلية.
lint_candidates.why: حيث used as a where-you-can linker chains clauses the English way; casual Arabic starts a new clause.

lint_candidates.replacement: Join list items with و (برجر وبيتزا وحلا) or keep the best two.
lint_candidates.why: A comma before the last و (X، Y، وZ) copies English list punctuation; Arabic links list items with و.

lint_candidates.replacement: Open with the news itself: فرعنا الجديد في الخبر فتح اليوم.
lint_candidates.why: Corporate salutations and we-are-pleased-to-announce openers are the Arabic greeting opener and make a post read like a circular.

lint_candidates.replacement: Ask one real question in dialect: وش طلبكم المفضل؟
lint_candidates.why: Mention-a-friend, type-done-in-the-comments and share-this-post lines are engagement bait.

lint_candidates.replacement: One concrete CTA in dialect: اطلبوا من التطبيق, احجزوا قبل الخميس, الحقوا (Egyptian, Levantine), لا يفوتكم (Gulf).
lint_candidates.why: Template CTAs (اعرف المزيد, اكتشف المزيد, لا تفوت الفرصة, سارع بالحجز) carry no action or deadline.

lint_candidates.replacement: Replace with the material, the taste or the number: جلد طبيعي, حار ومقرمش, ضمان سنتين.
lint_candidates.why: Purple praise (سيمفونية النكهات, لمسة من الفخامة, تأسر الحواس, الأصالة والحداثة) and hollow intensifiers (مهم للغاية) signal template copy.
lint_candidates.evidence: amwaly.com lists مهم للغاية (read); the rest is inference

lint_candidates.replacement: Write the line in Arabic script unless the brand already posts in Arabizi to a youth audience.
lint_candidates.why: Arabizi (a7la, ya3ni) is peer chat, mostly Levantine, Egyptian and Moroccan youth, and looks like a stunt in brand copy that does not already use it.
lint_candidates.evidence: Wikipedia, Arabic chat alphabet, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_chat_alphabet and Levantine Arabic, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levantine_Arabic (read)

lint_candidates.match: \ben (un|el) mundo (donde|en el que|en que|cada vez m[aá]s|actual|de hoy|moderno)\b|\ben el (vertiginoso|din[aá]mico|competitivo|cambiante|apasionante|fascinante|emocionante|fren[eé]tico) mundo\b|\ben la era (digital|actual|moderna|de la inmediatez)\b
lint_candidates.replacement: Open with the offer or the fact (what, price, date, place).
lint_candidates.why: Scene-setting openers such as En un mundo donde or En el vertiginoso mundo de delay the offer and are named by native writers as an AI habit.
lint_candidates.evidence: Luis Orlando León Carpio, 11 señales de que ChatGPT escribió tu texto, https://luisorlandolencarpio.substack.com/p/11-senales-de-que-chatgpt-escribio; Julita en Remoto, Copywriting con IA, https://julitaenremoto.com/copywriting-con-ia/; ADSLZone, palabras más usadas por ChatGPT, https://www.adslzone.net/noticias/ia/palabras-mas-usadas-chatgpt/

lint_candidates.replacement: Say what the person does or gets: Pruébalo, Ven a verlo (ES, MX), Vení a verlo (AR), or just name the product.
lint_candidates.why: Immersion verbs (sumérgete, adéntrate, embárcate) in every address form are listed by Spanish copywriters as stock AI marketing verbs.
lint_candidates.evidence: Julita en Remoto, Copywriting con IA, https://julitaenremoto.com/copywriting-con-ia/; Borja Girón, palabras y frases que repite ChatGPT, https://borjagiron.com/palabras-frases-repite-chatgpt/; PostPro App Store listing (machine-made Spanish copy), https://apps.apple.com/hn/app/postpro-ai-for-posts-creation/id6462699110

lint_candidates.replacement: State the concrete gain: Tu café listo en 2 minutos, Vende más en diciembre.
lint_candidates.why: Growth calques (al siguiente nivel, eleva tu, potencia tu, desbloquea tu potencial, transforma tu vida) come from English marketing and read as AI or translated copy.
lint_candidates.evidence: Julita en Remoto, Copywriting con IA, https://julitaenremoto.com/copywriting-con-ia/; Borja Girón, palabras y frases que repite ChatGPT, https://borjagiron.com/palabras-frases-repite-chatgpt/; ADSLZone, palabras más usadas por ChatGPT, https://www.adslzone.net/noticias/ia/palabras-mas-usadas-chatgpt/; PostPro App Store listing (machine-made Spanish copy), https://apps.apple.com/hn/app/postpro-ai-for-posts-creation/id6462699110

lint_candidates.replacement: Name the product and one concrete detail (origin, hours of work, price) instead of the metaphor.
lint_candidates.why: Purple set pieces (descubre la magia de, un viaje de sabores, un tapiz de, donde la tradición se encuentra con la modernidad) are generic model phrasing, several of them calques of English.

lint_candidates.replacement: Replace the adjective with the fact that makes it special: Cena en la terraza con vistas, 45 € por persona.
lint_candidates.why: Experiencia única or inolvidable and the ¿Sabías que...? hook are generic promises a native copywriter lists as AI filler, though brands also use them natively.
lint_candidates.evidence: Julita en Remoto, Copywriting con IA, https://julitaenremoto.com/copywriting-con-ia/

lint_candidates.match: \b(cabe (destacar|se[nñ]alar|mencionar|resaltar)|es importante (destacar|se[nñ]alar|mencionar|tener en cuenta|recordar|resaltar)|vale la pena (destacar|se[nñ]alar|mencionar|resaltar)|en resumen|en conclusi[oó]n|en [uú]ltima instancia)\b|\b(juega|juegan|jugar|desempe[nñ]a|desempe[nñ]an|desempe[nñ]ar)\s+un\s+papel\s+(fundamental|crucial|clave|esencial|vital|decisivo)\b
lint_candidates.replacement: Delete the connector and state the point; an ad needs no summary.
lint_candidates.why: Essay connectors and closers (cabe destacar, es importante destacar, en resumen) and the inflated juega un papel crucial are textbook register that Spanish articles list as ChatGPT tells.
lint_candidates.evidence: Genbeta, https://www.genbeta.com/inteligencia-artificial/estas-palabras-frases-tus-textos-dejan-claro-has-usado-chatgpt; Borja Girón, palabras y frases que repite ChatGPT, https://borjagiron.com/palabras-frases-repite-chatgpt/; Maldita.es, https://maldita.es/malditatecnologia/20250917/detectar-textos-generados-inteligencia-artificial/; Instituto Cervantes CVC, jugar un papel, https://cvc.cervantes.es/lengua/alhabla/museo_horrores/museo_052.htm (jugar un papel is an accepted gallicism, the inflated form is the tell)

lint_candidates.replacement: Say the one thing it is, with a fact: Hamburguesa doble con cheddar, 8,90 €.
lint_candidates.why: Named in copy.md, not yet linted: the No es solo X, es Y antithesis is a calqued frame that a native writer lists first among AI signs.
lint_candidates.evidence: Luis Orlando León Carpio, 11 señales de que ChatGPT escribió tu texto, https://luisorlandolencarpio.substack.com/p/11-senales-de-que-chatgpt-escribio

lint_candidates.replacement: Sentence case: capital on the first word and proper nouns only (Nueva colección de verano).
lint_candidates.why: Named in copy.md, not yet linted: English Title Case (a capitalised De, Para or Tu mid-line, or four capitalised words in a row) is spotted by Spanish editors as a ChatGPT sign.

lint_candidates.replacement: Use the simple future or present: Enviaremos, Te enviamos, Anunciamos a los ganadores el lunes.
lint_candidates.why: Estaremos enviando copies the English future progressive (we will be sending); Spanish uses the simple future unless two actions overlap (te estaremos esperando is excluded).

lint_candidates.replacement: Split into two sentences or use para or así: Hidrata en 5 minutos. Tu piel, lista para el día.
lint_candidates.why: A trailing gerund clause (, permitiéndote..., haciendo que...) is the normative error gerundio de posterioridad and a common machine sentence shape.
lint_candidates.evidence: Fundéu Guzmán Ariza, gerundio de posterioridad (snippet), https://fundeu.do/gerundio-de-posterioridad-restricciones-de-uso/; AI link is inference

(de|por|con) (anunciar|compartir|presentar|contar|lanzar)\b|\b(si[eé]ntete|si[eé]ntase|si[eé]ntanse|sentite|sent[ií]os)\s+libres?\s+de\b|\b(toma|tom[aá]|tome|tomen|tomar)\s+ventaja\s+de\b|\b(mantente|mant[eé]ngase|mant[eé]nganse|mantenete|manteneos)\s+sintonizad[oa]s?\b|\bya sea que\b|\bespero que este (mensaje|correo|e-?mail) (te|le|les|los|las) encuentre bien\b|\b(enlace|link|v[ií]nculo) (en|de) (la |nuestra |mi )?biograf[ií]a\b
lint_candidates.replacement: Native lines: Tenemos novedades; Escríbenos cuando quieras; Aprovecha; Muy pronto os contamos más; tanto si... como si; link en bio.
lint_candidates.why: Literal translations of English announcement and CTA lines (excited to announce, feel free to, take advantage of, stay tuned, whether, hope this finds you well, link in bio) are machine translation tells.
lint_candidates.evidence: inference (the email opener is flagged in Portuguese by Sabbatini and Stork, see pt candidates)

lint_candidates.replacement: Reflexive plus article: Lávate las manos, Cepíllate los dientes (AR: Lavate las manos).
lint_candidates.why: A possessive with body parts (lava tus manos) copies English your hands; Spanish uses the reflexive and the article.

lint_candidates.replacement: según or a partir de for en base a; en or con respecto a for a nivel de; postúlate or solicita for aplica a.

lint_candidates.replacement: Say it straight: Masa madre de 48 horas, por eso cruje.
lint_candidates.why: The one-word question hook (¿La trampa?, ¿El resultado?) followed by the answer is named by a native writer as a recurring AI transition.
lint_candidates.evidence: Luis Orlando León Carpio, 11 señales de que ChatGPT escribió tu texto, https://luisorlandolencarpio.substack.com/p/11-senales-de-que-chatgpt-escribio

lint_candidates.replacement: Delete the chatbot wrapper; keep only the copy.
lint_candidates.why: Chatbot wrapper text (¡Claro! Aquí tienes..., Como modelo de lenguaje...) pasted into a post is an unedited AI leftover.

lint_candidates.replacement: Cut the greeting; open with the news or the offer.
lint_candidates.why: Greeting openers (Hola a todos, Estimado cliente, Buenos días) waste the first line of a post or banner; the lint only knew English and Bengali greetings.

lint_candidates.replacement: Ask a real question about the product (¿Con qué salsa la pides?) or drop the ask.
lint_candidates.why: Engagement bait (etiqueta a un amigo, dale like si, comenta si) is generic and platforms demote it.

lint_candidates.replacement: Add the fact that makes it urgent (hasta el domingo, quedan 20); say corre or date prisa (ES), apúrate (MX), apurate (AR) instead of apresúrate.

lint_candidates.replacement: Name the action and the payoff: Reserva tu mesa, Pide en la app, Ver horarios.

lint_candidates.match: (?:کی جانب سے|کے ذریعے|بذریعہ) [^۔،]{0,40}?(?:کیا|کی|کیے|کئے|بنایا|بنائی|بنائے) (?:جاتا|جاتی|جاتے|گیا|گئی|گئے|جائے گا|جائے گی|جائیں گے)

lint_candidates.replacement: spoken present: இருக்கு, கிடைக்குது, வருது, தர்றோம், பண்றோம்
lint_candidates.why: Written present tense (-கிறது, -கின்றோம்) makes a caption read like a notice, and machine translation defaults to it.
lint_candidates.evidence: Schiffman, Standard Spoken Tamil (UPenn), http://ccat.sas.upenn.edu/~haroldfs/public/stantam/STANTAM.HTM; Sariya, Why Google Translate Fails at Tamil, https://www.sariya.app/blog/why-google-translate-fails-tamil

lint_candidates.replacement: இருக்கு / இருக்காங்க / பண்ணியிருக்கோம் / வந்தாச்சு
lint_candidates.why: உள்ளது and the perfect -துள்ளது are written forms that spoken Tamil replaces with இருக்கு or -ஆச்சு.

lint_candidates.replacement: -ங்க / -ாதீங்க (பண்ணுங்க, வாங்க, மிஸ் பண்ணிடாதீங்க)
lint_candidates.why: Formal imperatives ending in -ுங்கள் or -ாதீர்கள் belong to notices; social copy uses the spoken -ங்க forms.
lint_candidates.evidence: Sariya, Tamil verbs spoken vs formal, https://www.sariya.app/dictionary/tamil-common-verbs; inference for the lint

lint_candidates.replacement: கால் பண்ணுங்க, வந்து பாருங்க, ரெஜிஸ்டர் பண்ணுங்க
lint_candidates.why: Infinitive plus -வும் commands are UI and circular style; in a caption they sound like an office notice.
lint_candidates.evidence: Microsoft Tamil Localization Style Guide, https://aka.ms/tamil-styleguide (UI examples use this form); inference for social

lint_candidates.replacement: X பண்ணுங்க (ஆர்டர் பண்ணுங்க, புக் பண்ணுங்க)
lint_candidates.why: English verbs in Tamil take பண்ணு, so an English loan joined to bookish செய்யுங்கள் is a half-translated mix.
lint_candidates.evidence: Wikipedia, Tanglish, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanglish; Schiffman, Standard Spoken Tamil (UPenn), http://ccat.sas.upenn.edu/~haroldfs/public/stantam/STANTAM.HTM; Sariya, Tamil verbs spoken vs formal, https://www.sariya.app/dictionary/tamil-common-verbs

lint_candidates.replacement: active spoken verb: தர்றோம், கிடைக்கும், திறந்தாச்சு
lint_candidates.why: The -ப்படு passive (is provided, has been opened) is written and translated; spoken copy says who does it.
lint_candidates.evidence: Microsoft Tamil Localization Style Guide, https://aka.ms/tamil-styleguide (avoid passive, rewrites அமைக்கப்பட்டிருந்தால்)

lint_candidates.replacement: name the action: சாப்பிட்டு பாருங்க, ட்ரை பண்ணுங்க, கடைக்கு வந்து பாருங்க

lint_candidates.replacement: state the gain: 2 மடங்கு ஸ்பீடு, பில் பாதியா குறையும்
lint_candidates.why: Calque of to new heights or next level; vague and clearly translated.

lint_candidates.replacement: name the real step: முதல் க்ளாஸ் ஃப்ரீ, இன்னைக்கே ஆரம்பிங்க
lint_candidates.why: பயணம் as a metaphor for a routine or a purchase copies the English your journey.

lint_candidates.replacement: say the fact instead: கும்பகோணம் டிகிரி காபி, ₹35
lint_candidates.why: Tamil form of the not just X, it is Y parallelism, with literary அல்ல that speech never uses.
lint_candidates.evidence: Wikipedia, Signs of AI writing (negative parallelisms), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Signs_of_AI_writing; Tamil form is inference

lint_candidates.replacement: X மட்டும் இல்ல, Y கூட

lint_candidates.evidence: Wikipedia, Signs of AI writing (negative parallelisms), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Signs_of_AI_writing; Tamil form is inference

lint_candidates.replacement: நீங்க, உங்க, நம்ம, உங்களோட, என்னோட

lint_candidates.evidence: ProofTamil, 10 Common Tamil Grammar Mistakes, https://www.prooftamil.com/blog/common-tamil-grammar-mistakes; Microsoft Tamil Localization Style Guide, https://aka.ms/tamil-styleguide (uses நீங்கள் for UI)

lint_candidates.replacement: வேணும் / வேணுமா?

lint_candidates.evidence: Schiffman, Standard Spoken Tamil (UPenn), http://ccat.sas.upenn.edu/~haroldfs/public/stantam/STANTAM.HTM; Sariya, Tamil verbs spoken vs formal, https://www.sariya.app/dictionary/tamil-common-verbs

lint_candidates.replacement: drop the opener and lead with the offer

lint_candidates.match: 在(当今|當今)|(快节奏|快節奏|瞬息万变|瞬息萬變)的(时代|時代|世界|社会|社會)

lint_candidates.replacement: Say what it does for the reader in one plain clause.

lint_candidates.match: 值得(注意|一提)的是|总而言之|總而言之|综上所述|綜上所述|总的来说|總的來說
lint_candidates.replacement: Cut the connector and say the point, or use 还有 / 另外.
lint_candidates.why: Essay connectors and wrap-up closers are high-frequency AI markers and almost never appear in real captions.

lint_candidates.replacement: One point per line with no numbering words.
lint_candidates.why: 首先 / 其次 / 最后 scaffolding turns a caption into a school essay.

lint_candidates.replacement: Name the actual effect, for example 出图快一倍 or 少填两步.
lint_candidates.why: 赋能 is the emblem of 互联网黑话 and of AI business copy; shoppers do not talk like this.

lint_candidates.match: 抓手|闭环|閉環|底层逻辑|底層邏輯|颗粒度|顆粒度|全链路|全鏈路|心智
lint_candidates.replacement: A plain verb with a concrete object.
lint_candidates.why: Corporate jargon reads like an internal slide deck when it lands in consumer social copy.

lint_candidates.match: [进進]行(了)?(一次|一场|一場|一下)?(购买|購買|体验|體驗|了解|分享|选择|選擇|升级|升級|优化|優化|推荐|推薦|使用|预约|預約|咨询|諮詢)
lint_candidates.replacement: Drop 进行 and use the verb itself: 买, 试, 约, 问.
lint_candidates.why: 进行 plus a verb is the Europeanised construction Yu Guangzhong criticised and a common machine translation and AI output.
lint_candidates.evidence: 余光中 怎样改进英式中文 https://www.cnblogs.com/poterliu/p/12131998.html ; JameCling https://www.jamecling.com/archives/1175

lint_candidates.replacement: Use 用 / 靠, or drop the phrase.
lint_candidates.why: 通过…的方式 adds words without meaning and is a translationese padding pattern.

lint_candidates.match: 是一[个個](非常|十分|极其|極其|相当|相當)
lint_candidates.replacement: Drop 是一个: 这个颜色很耐看.
lint_candidates.why: 是一个非常…的 mirrors English 'is a very' and reads translated.
lint_candidates.evidence: inference (the wider Europeanised pattern is in 余光中 https://www.cnblogs.com/poterliu/p/12131998.html)

lint_candidates.match: 至[关關]重要|不可或缺|意[义義]重大|不可磨[灭滅]
lint_candidates.replacement: Give the one fact that shows why it matters.
lint_candidates.why: Importance inflation words are listed by Chinese Wikipedia editors as signs of LLM text.
lint_candidates.evidence: Wikipedia:AI生成文的特徵 https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:AI生成文的特徵

lint_candidates.replacement: Say what happens: 来吃, 来逛, 来试.

lint_candidates.match: 接住(了)?(你|妳|您|每一|所有|大家)|[稳穩][稳穩]地?接住
lint_candidates.replacement: Say the real help, for example 加班到十点也有热饭.

lint_candidates.evidence: CTWANT 2026-04-27 https://www.ctwant.com/article/478834/ ; Wikipedia:AI生成文的特徵 https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:AI生成文的特徵

lint_candidates.match: 以下是.{0,15}(文案|版本|内容|內容|标题|標題)|希望(这|這|以上).{0,6}(对|對)(你|您)有(帮助|幫助)|作[为為]一[个個]?(AI|人工智能|人工智慧|语言模型|語言模型)
lint_candidates.replacement: Delete the chatbot framing and keep only the post.

lint_candidates.evidence: Wikipedia:AI生成文的特徵 https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:AI生成文的特徵

lint_candidates.match: ^\s*((尊敬|亲爱|親愛)的.{0,4}(客户|客戶|用户|用戶|顾客|顧客|会员|會員|朋友|粉丝|粉絲)|大家好)
lint_candidates.replacement: Open with the news itself.
lint_candidates.why: Letter and SMS greetings make a social caption read like a service notice.

lint_candidates.match: @你的(好友|朋友|闺蜜|閨蜜|搭子|姐妹)|[评評][论論][区區]扣1|(点赞|點讚|點贊)[+＋]?(收藏|关注|關注)
lint_candidates.replacement: Ask a real question about the product, or drop the ask.

lint_candidates.match: 还在等什么|還在等什麼|赶快行动|趕快行動|快[来來](体验|體驗|抢购|搶購)吧

lint_candidates.match: 了解更多|[点點][击擊]了解
lint_candidates.replacement: Name the action and payoff: 点链接领券, 私信拿价目表.
lint_candidates.why: A vague CTA that says nothing about what the reader gets.

lint_candidates.replacement: zh-TW: 影片, 品質, 預設. zh-HK: 影片, 質素, 預設.
lint_candidates.why: A Mainland word written in Traditional characters means the text was auto-converted.

lint_candidates.match: (我們|你們|他們|這個|那個)(嘅|咗|係)
lint_candidates.replacement: Pick one register: 我哋嘅 (Cantonese) or 我們的 (書面語).
lint_candidates.why: Mandarin pronouns glued to Cantonese particles is a machine or non-native mix in Hong Kong copy.
lint_candidates.evidence: inference (register split per 粵語白話文 https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/粵語白話文)

lint_candidates.match: [织織]就|[编編][织織]出|交[织織]成|[画畫]卷|承[载載]着?.{0,6}(记忆|記憶|温度|溫度|情怀|情懷)|根植[于於]
lint_candidates.replacement: Name the real things: the street, the dish, the price.
lint_candidates.why: Tapestry imagery such as 画卷, 织就 and 承载记忆 is the Chinese face of model purple prose.
lint_candidates.evidence: 新智元 via 腾讯新闻 https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20260218A05JKN00 (tapestry) ; Wikipedia:AI生成文的特徵 (根植于)

lint_candidates.match: いかがでした(か|でしょうか)
lint_candidates.replacement: End on the offer or a real question about the product.
lint_candidates.why: The SEO-blog sign-off that models reproduce; fine after a real event, stiff as a closer on a product post.
lint_candidates.evidence: inference (seen only in a search summary, not on a page opened)

lint_candidates.match: (について|を)探っていきましょう|について解説(します|していきます)
lint_candidates.replacement: Show the thing directly.
lint_candidates.why: Lecture framing from blog and chatbot writing; a post should just show the thing.

lint_candidates.match: と言えるでしょう|と考えられます|と思われます|以上のことから|結論として
lint_candidates.replacement: State the fact with です, or cut the sentence.
lint_candidates.why: Hedges and report closers make copy sound like an essay; ads state facts.
lint_candidates.evidence: Qiita @robitan https://qiita.com/robitan/items/76af9fa8b82c0f9c739f ; くらべるAI https://kuraberuai.fioriera.co.jp/useful-content/remove-ai-like/ ; hachimakivenda https://www.hachimakivenda.com/3591

lint_candidates.replacement: One point per line; no numbering words.
lint_candidates.why: Numbered essay scaffolding is a known ChatGPT habit in Japanese.

lint_candidates.match: 可能性を解き放|潜在能力を引き出|新たな基準を設定|業界を再定義|未来を変える|ゲームチェンジャー|パラダイムシフト|フロンティアを開拓|魔法のように|革命的な
lint_candidates.replacement: Say the concrete gain: 3分で予約完了.

lint_candidates.match: 新たな(高み|扉|ステージ|次元)|の世界へようこそ|新しい扉を開
lint_candidates.replacement: Drop the metaphor and name the offer.
lint_candidates.why: Journey and doorway metaphors carried over from English launch copy.

lint_candidates.match: (今日|現代|今)の.{0,12}(世界|社会|時代)において|急速に変化する
lint_candidates.replacement: Start with the product fact.
lint_candidates.why: The rapidly changing world opener in Japanese; において reads translated in a post.

lint_candidates.replacement: Say what it is; if the frame is needed, ただの…じゃない is the native ad form.

lint_candidates.match: することができます|することが可能です
lint_candidates.replacement: できます, or the plain verb.
lint_candidates.why: A wordy, translation-style ability form.

lint_candidates.replacement: いたします or します (休業いたします).

lint_candidates.match: (お|ご)[一-龥][一-龥ぁ-ん]{0,4}になられ|おっしゃられ
lint_candidates.replacement: お読みになる, いらっしゃる, おっしゃる.
lint_candidates.why: Double honorifics of the お読みになられる type are called generally inappropriate by the Agency for Cultural Affairs.
lint_candidates.evidence: 文化庁 敬語の指針 2007 https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkashingikai/kokugo/hokoku/pdf/keigo_tosin.pdf

lint_candidates.match: 以下は.{0,12}(案|例|キャッチコピー|投稿文)|もちろんです[！!。]|お役に立てれば幸い
lint_candidates.replacement: Delete the chatbot framing and keep only the post.
lint_candidates.why: Chatbot framing left in the copy.
lint_candidates.evidence: inference (Chinese Wikipedia lists the same leftovers for Chinese)

lint_candidates.match: (皆様|皆さま|みなさま|皆さん|みなさん)、?こんにちは|お客様各位
lint_candidates.replacement: Open with the news itself.
lint_candidates.why: Letter and notice openers make a post read like a circular.

lint_candidates.replacement: Drop it, or run a proper follow and repost campaign.
lint_candidates.why: 'Tag a friend' is an English engagement calque that Japanese posts rarely use.

lint_candidates.match: 詳しくはこちら|詳細はこちら
lint_candidates.replacement: Say what the reader gets: 予約はプロフィールのリンクから.
lint_candidates.why: A generic link CTA; common natively, so only a nudge.

lint_candidates.replacement: Single 、 or 。.
lint_candidates.why: Doubled 、、 or 。。 is a marker of おじさん構文, which younger readers find off-putting.
lint_candidates.evidence: Japanese Wikipedia おじさん構文 https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/おじさん構文

lint_candidates.match: ソリューション|エンゲージメント|シームレスな|シナジー|エンパワー|ウェルビーイング
lint_candidates.replacement: Say what it fixes in plain Japanese.
lint_candidates.why: Business katakana is unclear to many readers; a NINJAL survey found 46.7% say loanwords block understanding.
lint_candidates.evidence: Japanese Wikipedia 「外来語」言い換え提案 https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/「外来語」言い換え提案

lint_candidates.replacement: Use a noun label or 次のとおりです。
lint_candidates.why: A predicate ending in a colon is an English-style lead-in that the textlint-ja preset flags.

lint_candidates.match: さあ[、,].{0,20}(ましょう|よう)|準備はできていますか
lint_candidates.replacement: Give the time and place instead of a hype hook.
lint_candidates.why: 'Let us...' and 'Are you ready?' hooks are calques of English ad openers.

lint_candidates.match: 織りなす|紡ぎ出す|物語を紡|至福のひととき|五感で(楽しむ|味わう|感じる)
lint_candidates.replacement: Keep at most one and pair it with a fact, or name the taste, texture or time.
lint_candidates.why: Stock poetic phrases that models reach for; natives use them too, so this is only a nudge.

lint_candidates.replacement: Spoken present or past: geldi, bekliyoruz, açığız.
lint_candidates.why: The written -mAktAdIr tense (sunmaktadır, buluşmaktadır) and extra -DIr belong to reports and translations, not social posts.
lint_candidates.evidence: Savaş Kılıç, ÇEVBİR Türkçe Notları, +DIr: Her Zaman Gerekli Midir?, https://cevbir.org.tr/turkce-notlari/dir-her-zaman-gerekli-midir/ (read); Doğal Metin AI sample, https://dogalmetin.com.tr/yapay-zeka-metin-insanlastirici (read)

lint_candidates.replacement: State the concrete effect: Kahven 3 dakikada hazır.
lint_candidates.why: Report stock phrases (önemli bir rol oynamaktadır, katkı sağlamaktadır, beraberinde getiriyor, bu çerçevede) are named by Turkish editors as AI tells.
lint_candidates.evidence: İrem Alimoğlu, Marketing Türkiye, 21 Dec 2025, https://www.marketingturkiye.com.tr/haberler/yazinin-yeni-suphesi-bu-metni-kim-yazdi/ (read); Doğal Metin AI sample (read)

lint_candidates.replacement: Open with the offer, the time or the place.
lint_candidates.why: Günümüzde and hızla değişen dünyada openers are listed as AI framing and add nothing to a post.

lint_candidates.replacement: Say the one point: Taban yumuşak, bütün gün rahat.
